constraints.rights: External references only. Original factual paraphrases. No source imagery, footage, audio, tracing, mocap or third-party assets embedded or reproduced. Public access is not a reproduction license.
constraints.adultScope: Sources with explicit adult condition context and those with inferred adult clinical/service context are distinguished. No source establishes universal adult suitability.
constraints.geometry: Angles, proportions, camera, easing and cycle duration are independent design choices except explicitly documented numeric facts for a specific source variant. No chosen geometry is an observed source measurement.
constraints.anatomicalSide: Supine active left/right is anatomical. Side-lying active upper right limb implies left-side support, and vice versa. This is an authored side convention; screen mirroring does not change anatomy.
constraints.stationaryContacts: Keep explicitly stated contacts distinct from plausible anatomical inferences and authored fixed contacts. Missing head/hand/support details are unresolved.
constraints.timestamps: No video or motion frames observed; no source media timestamps. Text page/section locators are actual evidence points.
constraints.approval: Source-checked facts do not increment exact assets, professional approval, or catalog motion review. All proposed procedural models remain draft-only and unmapped.
constraints.playback: Any later lab viewer must remain paused by default with explicit controls, one cycle only, static start/end and reduced-motion alternatives; no autoplay or production mapping is authorized by this ledger.
